page.layout: Two printed pages on one scan. Left page: blank, no text. Right page: the right-hand printed page is cut off by the scan edge; only its outer part shows a title page, with a few lines visible at the far right.
page.notes: The left printed page is blank. The right page is cut off by the scan edge, so most of its title lines are lost; the visible fragments are copied as far as they can be read. Some lines are only partly legible. Shelf marks and the digitiser's banner are left out.
